content.text:
Fixed: a camera's `up` vector now survives a save and reload, but I haven't run any tests or the issue's example code.

The bug was that the up vector was never written out when an object was serialized, so `ObjectLoader` had nothing to restore and left it at the default (0,1,0). It affected every 3D object, not just cameras. I made two one-line changes:

- **`src/core/Object3D.js`**: `toJSON()` now writes `object.up = this.up.toArray()` next to the matrix.
- **`src/loaders/ObjectLoader.js`**: `parseObject()` now reads it back with `if ( data.up !== undefined ) object.up.fromArray( data.up );`. Older JSON files without an `up` field still load and keep the default.

Every serialized object now carries an extra `up` field. The existing unit tests for `Object3D.toJSON()` may compare the output field by field, so they could need updating; I left them as they are.
